<thought>We need to locate a retrosynthetic template that corresponds to converting an aliphatic carboxylic acid into an amide (C–O bond broken, C–N bond formed). The tool `search_template_catalog_by_criteria` accepts functional group criteria, so we will query using the broken functional group “aliphatic carboxylic acid” and the formed functional group “amide”. This should return relevant templates; we can then select the first result.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)Nc3ccccc3N)cc2)cc1",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["aliphatic carboxylic acid"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["amide"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
